source: CC c0_invalid_resume, 2026-09-30 re-probe, Claude Code 2.1.285; adaptations: see the replay fixture's source

unasserted.why: the fixture replays exit 1 with the 'No conversation found' stderr line; the schema has no field for TurnEvidence.exit (C2 §2), so the ExitReport is not compared. stderr is never read (vendor spec, stderr row), so it cannot change any asserted field

expect.notes: The --resume argument is captured: the driver passes sessions.main.resume and asserts the fake's captured value equals it. --resume of a missing session gives a pre-init result (error_during_execution, num_turns 0, errors 'No conversation found ...') that echoes the requested UUID. A pre-init rejection never confirms identity or opens (C2 §2 delayed identity); the definite, fixture-backed missing-session rejection is StartRejected::SessionGone and the same VIA session is kept (packet §2). No init was read, so vendor_version is null (C2 §5). The rejection carries TurnEvidence (C2 §2 AdapterError::Rejected): the launched process exited, so cleanup is quiescent on Host's group cleanup evidence.
